title: Ember Orchard: The Cartographer's Seed Archive
premise: In a volcanic garden whose fruit germinates in cooling ash, the cartographer must chart hidden passages before nightfall using a living contour chart.
ending: Recover the Seed Archive and return with the charted evacuation line; Orchard Keepers can finally verify the source testimony.
challenge: Survive thermal surge while evading the ashwood guardian without sacrificing the charted evacuation line.
choice_yes: Disclose evidence and ask Orchard Keepers to witness the living contour chart.
choice_no: Keep the evidence sealed until the expedition's replay record is complete.
dilemma: whether to publish an unsafe shortcut
